ConfigApp.Connection.cardDescription: You can find your API credentials in the <portal>merchant portal</portal>.
ConfigApp.Connection.disconnectConfirmBo: Disconnecting removes everything saved for this environment, including its payment method settings. You can reconnect at any time.
ConfigApp.Connection.keyPrefixError: The {field} for the {env} environment must start with “{prefix}”.
ConfigApp.Connection.marketingBody: Make sure that you’re logged in to the <portal>merchant portal</portal> because you need to copy several settings from there to fill in the information below. If you don’t have an account, <contact>contact us here</contact>.
ConfigApp.Connection.marketingHeading: UnzerOne: one platform for all channels and the ideal customer experience.
ConfigApp.Connection.rightBody: Attract shoppers from across the globe. Allow them to choose from 200 national and international payment methods. Whether in your online shop or your business. Regardless of currency. All easy and affordable for you.
ConfigApp.Connection.rightHeading: All payment methods, 160 countries, all currencies
ConfigApp.Connection.rotationConfirmBody: These API keys belong to a different Unzer account. If you continue, this environment will be disconnected from the currently connected account.
ConfigApp.Connection.rotationConfirmWarn: All existing configuration will be deleted.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.alipay: Alipay, the payment method from China’s Alibaba, is the most used online payment method in China.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.applepay: Apple Pay is a mobile wallet solution available to all users of Apple devices.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.bancontact: Bancontact is the most popular online payment method in Belgium, with over 15 million cards in circulation.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.card: Cards can be differentiated in credit and debit cards. In most cases they are issued by banks (issuers) in cooperation with card organizations (schemes) such as Mastercard, VISA, Diners, or American Express.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.eps: Electronic Payment Standard (EPS) is a popular online payment method available in Austria.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.googlepay: Google Pay is a mobile wallet solution available to all the customers who have a Google account.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.ideal: iDEAL | Wero is one of the most popular online payment methods in the Netherlands. It generates a SEPA Credit Transfer from within the consumer’s trusted online banking portal.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.klarna: Klarna is a payment method that provides an easy to use pay later payment option.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.openbankingP: Direct Bank Transfer is a payment method based on the payment initiation service. It is based on open banking technology and enables the customer to securely log into their bank account using their standard credentials and method to initiate a direct payment.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.paylaterDire: Direct Debit is a part of our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) offering and it’s a convenient payment option. This payment option offers customers an easy and secure way to shop online or in-store without having to manually perform payments.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.paylaterInst: Unzer Installment is a part of our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) offering and it’s a very convenient payment option.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.paylaterInvo: Unzer Invoice is a part of our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) offering and it’s a convenient payment option.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.paypal: PayPal is one of the most widely used online wallets, letting customers pay with a balance, bank account or card without sharing those details with the shop.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.payu: PayU is an online bank transfer. It is one of the most popular payment methods amongst Polish consumers.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.postFinanceC: PostFinance is an online direct payment method used by the Swiss customers for online payments. The currency is Swiss Franc (CHF).
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.postFinanceE: PostFinance is an online direct payment method used by the Swiss customers for online payments. The transaction currency is Swiss Franc (CHF).
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.prepayment: Prepayment is a safe and convenient payment method for merchants.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.przelewy24: Przelewy24 (P24) is one of the most popular online payment methods available in Poland.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.sepaDirectDe: SEPA Direct Debit is a payment method available in the European SEPA region and based on the EU SEPA rule book.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.twint: With TWINT, you can make convenient and secure payments with your smartphone - at the cash register in a supermarket, in an online shop, when shopping at a farm shop, on public transport, when parking, or when transferring money to your friends.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.wechatpay: WeChat Pay is a Chinese payment method tied to the most popular messaging service in China.
ConfigApp.MethodDescription.wero: Wero is the unified European payment solution that enables convenient and secure instant payments across Europe using just your smartphone. Whether you’re making peer-to-peer transfers with a phone number, shopping online, or making in-store payments with QR codes, Wero provides a seamless payment experience.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.amountsHint: Each amount is set per currency - pick the currency beside the field. A currency you leave empty has no limits and no surcharge.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.applePayLabelHi: Shown beside the total in the Apple payment sheet. Left empty, the shopper reads the store key instead.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.bookingHint: You can initialize the payment page to support either charge or authorize transactions.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.clickToPayDescr: Offer Click to Pay alongside the card form, so returning shoppers can pay with a card they have already enrolled.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.countriesHint: Select the countries where this payment method should be available.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.descriptionHint: The Unzer payment method description on the checkout.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.googlePayCountr: The countryCode must be set to the one submitted to Merchant upfront in the contract or in a separated email. Currently supported values are CH and DK. Default is DK.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.googlePayGatewa: Read from your Unzer account and stored with this method every time you save. If it stays empty, please contact Unzer support.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.googlePayMercha: From the Google Pay & Wallet Console. Until it is set, Google renders the payment sheet in test mode.
The name the shopper reads inside the Google payment sheet.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.nameHint: The Unzer payment method name on the checkout.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.sendBasketDescr: If this option is enabled, the basket data will always be sent to the Unzer API. This ensures that every transaction includes complete order details, providing better transparency and enabling more accurate processing through the Unzer system.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.surchargeHint: Specify an additional fee applied to this payment method.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.walletButtonTyp: What Google writes on its own button.
ConfigApp.MethodSettings.walletNetworksH: The networks your Unzer account is served this method for. Deselect one only to narrow what the wallet sheet offers.
ConfigApp.PaymentMethods.description: Here is the list of available payment methods for your merchant account. You can enable a payment method in your store by clicking on the toggle button.
ConfigApp.PaymentMethods.heading: Payment methods
ConfigApp.PaymentMethods.noMethods: No payment methods are available yet. They appear once the store is connected to Unzer.

ConfigApp.storesEmpty: This project has no stores with a key. Create a store first, then configure it here.
